restoration_note: This teaching is structured as an iterated catalogue: at four registers the Lord is named 'Father, his Greatness is X,' with each register described by 'rooted in him, established beneath him.' This formula constrains nearly all gaps. Editor restorations 0,1,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,15,16,17 are confirmed as expressions of the catalogue's recurring structure (Father of Greatness → Third Ambassador → Jesus the Radiance → Pillar of Glory). Gap 3 is filled with high confidence as the plural of the iterated formula. Gaps 2, 13, 14, 18 are weaker: gap 2 needs an appositional connector before ⲧⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ; gaps 13–14 introduce 'the five gods of [X]' as the Pillar of Glory's descriptor (proposing ⲡⲉⲁⲩ 'glory' as thematically consistent with the Pillar); gap 18 fits the partial trace ⲩⲉ within ϣⲁⲩⲙⲟⲩⲧⲉ ⲁⲣⲁⲩ. The spiritual logic — that 'Father' names the Lord wherever he stands as foundation beneath a lower order — is preserved at every register.
